messages.title: Welcome to PixelShelf!
messages.body:
After months of work, I’m thrilled to finally get this app into your hands. As a gamer and collector, building PixelShelf has been a passion project, and I hope it makes organizing your library a breeze.

​💡 Tip: Don't forget to link your Steam and Xbox accounts, there are some great features built into the app. Also, feel free to share your collection count on the leaderboard

​If you're enjoying the app, please consider sharing it with your friends or leaving a 5-star review on the Play Store. Your support makes all the difference! ❤️

​— PixelShelf Developer
